course.title: Digital Signal Processing
course.department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering

content.value: Consider the analog signal $x _ { a } ( t ) = 3 \cos { 1 0 0 } \pi t$
(i) Determine the minimum sampling rate to avoid aliasing.
(ii) Suppose that the signal is sampled at the rate $F _ { s } = 2 0 0 H z$ . What is the discrete-time signal obtained after sampling?
(iii) What is the discrete-time signal obtained after sampling if $F _ { s } = 7 5 H z ?$
(iv) What is the frequency $0 < F < F _ { s } / 2$ of a sinusoid that yields samples identical to those obtained in part (iii)?
